plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: MacroHall uses your location when you tap Check in, to find which dining hall or gym you're in. Your location is never stored, and friends only see the place name.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: If you turn on Automatic check-in, MacroHall is notified when you arrive at or leave your campus dining halls and gyms, so your gym visits and status update without opening the app. Your location is never stored.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: If you turn on Automatic check-in, MacroHall is notified when you arrive at or leave your campus dining halls and gyms, so your gym visits and status update without opening the app. Your location is never stored.

plugins.cameraPermission: MacroHall uses the camera when you photograph a dining hall menu board to share it with your campus.
plugins.photosPermission: MacroHall uses your photos when you attach a screenshot to a bug report.
